issue.author: ewlu
issue.body:
Full assertion:
```
Assertion `(BestFactor.Width == LegacyVF.Width || BestPlan.hasEarlyExit() || planContainsAdditionalSimplifications(getPlanFor(BestFactor.Width), CostCtx, OrigLoop, BestFactor.Width) || planContainsAdditionalSimplifications( getPlanFor(LegacyVF.Width), CostCtx, OrigLoop, LegacyVF.Width)) && " VPlan cost model and legacy cost model disagreed"' failed.
```

```llvm ir
target triple = "riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu"

  %idxprom5.i.us = sext i16 %v.051.i.us to i64

  store i8 %conv18.i.us, ptr %arrayidx22.i.us, align 1
  %arrayidx28.i.us = getelementptr [1 x i64], ptr null, i64 %idxprom5.i.us
  store i64 0, ptr %arrayidx28.i.us, align 8
  %add.i.us = add i16 %v.051.i.us, 4
  %conv.i.us = sext i16 %add.i.us to i32
  %cmp.i.us = icmp sgt i32 %sext.i, %conv.i.us
  br i1 %cmp.i.us, label %for.body.i.us, label %for.cond.i.us
}

attributes #0 = { "target-features"="+v" }

```

Sure!
The root cause of this case is that the VPWidenCast recipe (cost = 2) and the legacy `%conv18.i.us = trunc i32 %0 to i8` (cost = 1) misaligned which is caused by MinBW think that this `trunc` is trunc to `i16` instead of `i8`.

issue.title: [LoopVectorize]  Assertion `(BestFactor.Width == LegacyVF.Width || BestPlan.hasEarlyExit() || ... && " VPlan cost model and legacy cost model disagreed"' failed.

patch:
commit 35b9f204490cd0101100878effe05ef5116b3099
Author: Florian Hahn <flo@fhahn.com>
Date:   Mon Oct 20 22:31:15 2025 +0100

    [LV] Check for TruncInsts in canTruncateToMinimalBitwidth.
    
    TruncInst must truncate at most to their destination. Return false if
    MinBWs contains a destination size > the trunc result type size.
    
    Fixes https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/162688.

diff --git a/llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp b/llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp
index febdc54e666a..1cc91735bb22 100644
--- a/llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp
+++ b/llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp
@@ -1011,6 +1011,10 @@ public:
   /// \returns True if instruction \p I can be truncated to a smaller bitwidth
   /// for vectorization factor \p VF.
   bool canTruncateToMinimalBitwidth(Instruction *I, ElementCount VF) const {
+    // Truncs must truncate at most to their destination type.
+    if (isa_and_nonnull<TruncInst>(I) && MinBWs.contains(I) &&
+        I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() < MinBWs.lookup(I))
+      return false;
     return VF.isVector() && MinBWs.contains(I) &&
            !isProfitableToScalarize(I, VF) &&
            !isScalarAfterVectorization(I, VF);

tests.test_body:
target datalayout = "e-m:e-p:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-n32:64-S128"
target triple = "riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu"

define void @test_minbws_for_trunc(i32 %n, ptr noalias %p1, ptr noalias %p2) {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:                                             ; preds = %loop, %entry
  %iv = phi i16 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop ]
  %iv.ext = sext i16 %iv to i64
  %gep1 = getelementptr i32, ptr %p1, i64 %iv.ext
  %v1 = load i32, ptr %gep1, align 4
  %v1.trunc = trunc i32 %v1 to i16
  %gep2 = getelementptr [1 x [1 x i16]], ptr %p2, i64 %iv.ext
  store i16 %v1.trunc, ptr %gep2, align 2
  %v1.trunc.i8 = trunc i32 %v1 to i8
  %gep3 = getelementptr i8, ptr %p2, i64 %iv.ext
  store i8 %v1.trunc.i8, ptr %gep3, align 1
  %gep4 = getelementptr [1 x i64], ptr %p2, i64 %iv.ext
  store i64 0, ptr %gep4, align 8
  %iv.next = add i16 %iv, 4
  %iv.next.ext = sext i16 %iv.next to i32
  %cmp = icmp ne i32 %iv.next.ext, 1024
  br i1 %cmp, label %loop, label %exit

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop
  ret void
}
